text:
maya: Quick sync — release train for Wed. Need owners for launch windows: api-gateway, runner, embeddings. For each: who deploys, window (UTC), smoke owner, rollback bookmark. Drop replies. :rocket:

 david: api-gateway -> I got this. 09:30-10:00 UTC. canary 10% for 10m then ramp. I will run the smoke checks.

 oliver: runner -> I'll take 10:00-10:20 UTC. smoke script is in repo at infra/smoke/runner_smoke.sh. Rollback tag: rollback/runner/2026-03-25

 sarah: embeddings -> prefer Thurs 02:00 UTC (off-peak). If Wed required, 11:00-11:30. no DB migrations but model swap needs <5m warmup.

 maya: noted. api-gateway + runner on Wed morning seems fine. sarah if you can move embeddings to Thurs that'd reduce blast radius.

 oliver: adding rollback command here:
```
git fetch --tags origin
git checkout refs/tags/rollback/runner/2026-03-25
./deploy.sh --env=prod --no-wait
```

 david: smoke check for api-gateway:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://canary.redwood/api/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq '.ok'
```
I'll run this at +5m after canary.

 deploy-bot: Reserved window: 2026-03-25T09:30Z-11:30Z for release-train-15. Ticket #4532 linked. :white_check_mark:

 maya: perf note — keep tokenization length <512 for canaries. Batching ramp allowed after 10m stable.

 sarah: ok moving embeddings to Thurs 02:00 UTC, will post runbook and smoke checklist by EOD Tue.

 oliver: I'll do a simulated deploy in staging at 09:00 UTC Wed and ping here with results.

 david: thanks — adding me + oliver as emergency rollback contacts. maya, anything else?

 maya: assign smoke owners: david (api-gateway), oliver (runner), sarah (embeddings). I'll own post-deploy monitoring for first 30m. good luck :thumbsup:

 sarah: got it — will post runbook link: https://docs.internal/release-train-15/runbook

 oliver: staging sim passed 09:00 — latency ok, kv cache warmup ~12s. I'll trigger real canary on schedule.

 deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: release-train-15 will start 2026-03-25T09:30Z. Auto-fallback configured to model-variant-lite if metrics drop 5% in 5m.

 maya: perfect. If anything changes, update thread. End of sync.
